Shanghai Provisional Court,
Shanghai, November 25 1929.

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

With reference to your letter asking for a copy of the
reactionary printed matter as seized by the Koumintang Direc-
tory Committee of Bing-Kiang-hsien for the purpose of making
the investigations, I have to inform you that as the said
printed matter was not forwarded to this Court by the Kiangsu
Provincial Government, I am unable to forward you a copy as
requested.

| You are still requested to effect its prohibitions.

Showin Weizen Hsu,
President.
CHIN

（批：As they do not
have a copy +
we cannot get
one I am afraid.
The last para is
an impossibility.
File Rep
26/11）

上海临时法院，
上海，1929年11月25日。

致警务处处长，
上海工部局。

先生：

关于贵函要求提供邗江县国民党指导委员会查获的反动印刷品副本以便进行调查一事，兹告知，由于江苏省政府未将上述印刷品移送至本院，故无法按贵方要求提供副本。

| 仍请贵方执行查禁工作。

徐伟森（Showin Weizen Hsu，音译），
院长。
CHIN

（批注：既然他们没有副本，恐怕我们也弄不到一份。最后一段是不可能做到的。归档回复 11/26）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
CID REGISTRY
C. D. 668.
20. 11. 29.

November 20, 29.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your
communication of November 16 requesting action by
the Municipal Police in respect of a reactionary
propaganda article, sample of which was seized at
Ming Kiang Hsian ( ), and in reply to request
that you will be good enough to obtain for me copy
of the article in question to facilitate
investigation.

I should be glad if you would kindly notify
the concerned of the importance of forwarding
samples of books or literature with each request
for Police enquiries concerning communistic or
other objectionable printed matter.

Yours faithfully,
A/Director of Criminal Investigation.

逕啓者本月十
六号来函阅于平
江縣黨務指
導委員會查獲
反動宣傳品
一事謹悉為便
利調查故特將
該項刊物寄下
一份並祈論告
前途凡遇共產
或其他反
動文字該項文
件附寄一份以便
調查專此覆聞
此
致

1929年11月20日。

先生：

本人谨确认收到贵方11月16日来函，要求工部局警务处就一起在明江县（Ming Kiang Hsian，音译）查获的反动宣传文章样本采取行动，并答复贵方请求，望能惠赐该文章副本一份，以便利调查工作。

如蒙贵方通知有关方面，在每次就共产主义或其他令人反感的印刷品请求警方查询时，务必随函附上书籍或文献样本，本人将不胜感激。

此致，
敬礼，
代理刑事侦缉处处长。

File No. D 668
19.11.29
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
I suggest the Provincial Govt be
requested to obtain for us copy of the
propaganda article in question as being
necessary to investigation by the S.B.
It might also be pointed out at the same
time that it would be of considerable aid
to the Imperial Police if requests for
suppressive measures against publishers of
communist matter were accompanied in each
& every case by samples of the offending books
or literature.
Thos Robertson
C.I.D.

档案编号 D 668
1929年11月19日
（刑事侦缉处）办公备忘录

我建议请省政府为我们获取所涉宣传文章的副本，此乃特别班调查之必要。
同时亦可指出，若每次请求对共产主义出版物出版商采取查禁措施时，均能附上违禁书籍或文献的样本，将对日本帝国警察大有裨益。

托马斯·罗伯逊
刑事侦缉处
